summary: Julong Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, disclosing that Ms. Jinying Wang resigned from the audit committee effective June 9, 2026, and that Mr. Shengshan Sun was appointed as an independent director and member of the audit, compensation, and nominating committees. The resignation was not based on any disagreement. The board now has five members. The filing contains no deal terms or financial details. This is a routine board committee change, not a forced or abrupt departure, so it is classified as 'None' because it does not meet the threshold of a special situation.
